value.quote: For a faithful normal state with scalar centralizer in the stated standard-space representation, the formalized result converts positive modular spectral averages into uniformly bounded algebra elements. Given unit vectors in shrinking spectral bands around a real number $s$ and a positive limiting symmetric average for a bounded operator $T$, it finds a subsequence of bounded algebra elements whose images under $T$ stay uniformly nonzero and whose spectral bands have four times the original widths. The absolute bicentralizer conjecture is not included.

statements.name: Spectral intertwining rigidity
statements.text:
\label{thm:rigidity}
Let $M$ be a von Neumann algebra with a faithful normal state $\phi$ such
that $M_\phi=\C1$. Let $b:\R\curvearrowright M$ be a continuous
$\phi$-preserving action. Suppose that, for every $s\in\R$, every uniformly
bounded sequence $(w_n)$ in $M$, and every $a\in M$,
\begin{equation}\label{eq:flow-property}
  \norm{\phi w_n-e^s w_n\phi}_{M_*}\longrightarrow0
  \quad\Longrightarrow\quad
  w_na-b_s(a)w_n\longrightarrow0
  \quad\text{strongly}.
\end{equation}
Then $b_s=\id_M$ for every $s\in\R$.

statements.name: thm:main
statements.text:
\label{thm:main}
Let $N\subset M$ be a unital inclusion of von Neumann algebras with separable
preduals, and suppose that there is a faithful normal conditional expectation
$E_N:M\to N$. There exist a unital amenable von Neumann subalgebra $P\subset N$
and a faithful normal conditional expectation $F:N\to P$ such that
\[
 P'\cap c(M)=N'\cap c(M).
\]
Here amenable means injective.
